adhesiveSpheres.note: self-convergence, no external reference needed. Ratios near 2 for each doubling is first order in dr/delta, which is what the manuscript claims; near 1 would mean the error is not discretisation. Published: 2 pts -> 0.916, 8 -> 0.142, 32 -> 0.035.

percusYevick.note: per cent, max relative over 0.1 <= q <= 25. The table's quoted 0.12 % corresponds to the type-4 column; type 1 is an order of magnitude worse and is what the polydisperse route uses.

rmsa.note: rmsa_compute at the nine state points behind the table's 'exact (9/9)'. Without jscatter there is nothing to compare against here, so this records only that each point solves and returns a physical S(Q); the 9/9 claim itself needs jscatter or another Hayter-Penfold implementation to re-verify.
